name: Leslie Clark
source:
Height: 5'7"

Dreamy, forgetful, and easily distracted-not exactly your average detective, Leslie is  Richter's partner, believe it or not.

But Leslie is more shrewd than he lets on... especially when it comes to teasing Richter.
